name: Gaming Lore and Worlds
description: A set of questions about game universes, factions, heroes, mythology, and plot twists in iconic video games.

questions.question: What is the name of the planet that Orcs originate from in the Warcraft universe?
questions.explanation_correct: Draenor is the homeland of the Orcs, which was shattered and became known as Outland.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Azeroth is the main game world, Argus is the home of the Eredar/Legion, and Kesh is not a Warcraft planet.

questions.question: Which orc served as the first Warchief of the Horde during the First War after crossing the Dark Portal?
questions.explanation_correct: Blackhand the Destroyer was the puppet Warchief controlled behind the scenes by Gul'dan and the Shadow Council.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thrall founded the new Horde years later, Doomhammer overthrew Blackhand, and Hellscream led the Warsong clan.

questions.question: What is the name of Ciri's biological father in the Witcher universe?
questions.explanation_correct: The Emperor of Nilfgaard, Emhyr var Emreis, is Ciri's biological father, formerly cursed as Duny, the Urcheon of Erlenwald.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Geralt is her adoptive father via the Law of Surprise, Foltest was king of Temeria, and Radovid was king of Redania.

questions.question: In which Northern Kingdom is the witcher keep of Kaer Morhen located?
questions.explanation_correct: Kaer Morhen is situated in the wild mountain passes of the Kingdom of Kaedwen.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Redania is west of Kaedwen, Temeria is south (across the Pontar), and Aedirn borders them to the southeast.

questions.question: What is the name of the pro-human, secretive paramilitary organization led by the Illusive Man in Mass Effect?
questions.explanation_correct: Cerberus works to advance human interests in the galaxy at any cost, notably funding the Lazarus Project to revive Commander Shepard.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Systems Alliance is humanity's official government, Spectres are Citadel Council agents, and Eclipse is a mercenary group.

questions.question: What is the name of the genetic weapon created by the Salarians to halt Krogan population growth?
questions.explanation_correct: The Genophage drastically reduced Krogan fertility rates to prevent their expansion, creating a major lore conflict resolved in Mass Effect 3.
questions.explanation_incorrect: T-Virus is from Resident Evil, Leviathan Plague is incorrect, and Cordyceps is from The Last of Us.

questions.question: Who was the first Lord of Cinder to sacrifice himself to link the First Flame in Dark Souls?
questions.explanation_correct: Gwyn, the Lord of Sunlight, sacrificed himself to link the First Flame, becoming the husk known as the Lord of Cinder.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nito and the Witch of Izalith were other Lord Soul wielders, and Manus is the Father of the Abyss.

questions.question: What is the name of the health-restoring item carried by the Chosen Undead in Dark Souls?
questions.explanation_correct: Estus Flasks are filled at bonfires and serve as the primary healing mechanic throughout the Dark Souls trilogy.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Health Potion is generic, Flask of Crimson Tears is from Elden Ring, and Blood Vial is the healing item in Bloodborne.

questions.question: What is the name of the multidimensional empire that conquered Earth in just seven hours in the Half-Life universe?
questions.explanation_correct: The Combine (referred to as 'Our Benefactors') established a military dictatorship on Earth after the Seven Hour War.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Xen is the border world dimension, while Aperture and Black Mesa are competing Earth research corporations.

questions.question: What is the name of the sacred relic in the Zelda series, consisting of three golden triangles representing Power, Wisdom, and Courage?
questions.explanation_correct: The Triforce was left behind by the Golden Goddesses and grants the wishes of whoever touches it.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Master Sword is the blade of evil's bane, the Ocarina controls time, and Majora's Mask is a cursed artifact.

questions.question: What is the name of the tallest mountain in Skyrim, home to the High Hrothgar monastery of the Greybeards?
questions.explanation_correct: The Throat of the World is the highest peak in Tamriel, climbed via the Seven Thousand Steps to reach High Hrothgar.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Red Mountain is located in Morrowind, Solstheim is a northern island, and Mount Karb is fictional.

questions.question: What is the name of the wrist-mounted personal computer worn by Vault Dwellers in the Fallout series?
questions.explanation_correct: The Pip-Boy is a pre-war electronic device manufactured by RobCo Industries to monitor health, inventory, and maps.
questions.explanation_incorrect: G.E.C.K. is a terraforming kit, Stealth Boy grants invisibility, and Stalker Pad is from the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series.

questions.question: What is the name of the underwater dystopian city built by Andrew Ryan in the first BioShock game?
questions.explanation_correct: Rapture is a submarine metropolis established in 1946 to escape government regulation, collapsing due to civil war and ADAM addiction.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Columbia is the flying city of BioShock Infinite, Dunwall is from Dishonored, and Soma is the underwater facility in SOMA.

questions.question: What is the name of the daughter of Hatred, creator of Sanctuary, and main antagonist of Diablo IV?
questions.explanation_correct: Lilith, the Queen of Succubi, co-created the world of Sanctuary alongside the angel Inarius to escape the Eternal Conflict.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Andariel is the Maiden of Anguish, Cydaea is the Maiden of Lust, and Auriel is the Archangel of Hope.

questions.question: Which Daedric Prince of Destruction is the main antagonist of The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion?
questions.explanation_correct: Mehrunes Dagon seeks to conquer Cyrodiil by opening dimensional rifts called Oblivion Gates.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Molag Bal is the main villain of ESO, Sheogorath is the Prince of Madness, and Azura is the Prince of Dawn and Dusk.

questions.question: What is the name of the pilot of the SSV Normandy in the Mass Effect trilogy?
questions.explanation_correct: Jeff 'Joker' Moreau is the Normandy's exceptionally skilled helmsman, who has Vrolik's syndrome.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Kaidan is a biotic marine, Wrex is a Krogan mercenary, and Anderson is Shepard's mentor.

questions.question: What is the name of the multinational corporate front for the Templar Order in the modern-day setting of Assassin's Creed?
questions.explanation_correct: Abstergo Industries developed the Animus technology to explore genetic memories for Pieces of Eden.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aperture is from Portal, Umbrella is from Resident Evil, and Shinra is from Final Fantasy VII.

questions.question: What is the name of the collective of alien races that wages a holy war against humanity in the Halo series?
questions.explanation_correct: The Covenant is a religious alliance of species that worships the ancient Forerunners and seeks to activate the Halo rings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Combine is from Half-Life, the Borg from Star Trek, and the Locust from Gears of War.

questions.question: What is the name of the self-proclaimed prophet and founder of the floating city Columbia in BioShock Infinite?
questions.explanation_correct: Father Comstock is the antagonistic founder of Columbia, who is eventually revealed to be an alternate reality version of Booker DeWitt.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Andrew Ryan founded Rapture, Frank Fontaine was Ryan's rival, and Booker DeWitt is the protagonist.

questions.question: What is the name of the spiritual dimension separated from the mortal world by the Veil in the Dragon Age universe?
questions.explanation_correct: The Fade is the metaphysical realm of spirits and dreams, accessible to mages and traversed during sleep.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Abyss is generic fantasy, Outland is from Warcraft, and Shadowlands is from World of Warcraft.

questions.question: What is the name of the scientific research corporation where the Portal games take place?
questions.explanation_correct: Aperture Science Innovators was founded by Cave Johnson and serves as the setting for the Portal franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Black Mesa is the setting of Half-Life, Vault-Tec built the vaults in Fallout, and Abstergo is from AC.

questions.question: What is the name of the high elven Ranger-General who became the Banshee Queen and later Warchief of the Horde?
questions.explanation_correct: Sylvanas Windrunner was slain and resurrected by Arthas, eventually freeing herself to lead the Forsaken faction.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Jaina is a human mage, Tyrande is the Night Elf High Priestess, and Alleria is Sylvanas's older sister.

questions.question: What is the name of the archdemon, also known as the Sleeper, who serves as the final boss in the first Gothic game?
questions.explanation_correct: The Orcs worshipped the Sleeper under the name Krushak, who was banished back to his home dimension by the Nameless Hero.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Gomez is the leader of the Old Camp, Xardas is the mentor necromancer, and Beliar is the god of darkness.

questions.question: Which alien species does Garrus Vakarian, a loyal companion of Commander Shepard, belong to?
questions.explanation_correct: Garrus Vakarian is a member of the avian, highly disciplined military race known as the Turians.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Asari are monogendered biotics (e.g. Liara), Salarians are quick-thinking amphibians (e.g. Mordin), and Krogans are reptilian warriors (e.g. Wrex).

questions.question: What is the name of the black dragon, the World-Eater, who serves as the main antagonist of Skyrim?
questions.explanation_correct: Alduin the World-Eater is a dragon of immense power who seeks to consume the souls of Sovngarde to grow stronger.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Paarthurnax is a peaceful dragon ally, Odahviing is captured and ridden by the player, and Mirmulnir is the first dragon slain.

questions.question: What is the name of the island where the events of Gothic II take place, containing a port city and the Valley of Mines?
questions.explanation_correct: Khorinis is the island setting of Gothic II, featuring a medieval port city and the adjacent prison colony valley.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Myrtana is the mainland kingdom, Irdorath is the volcanic evil temple island, and Jharkendar is the hidden valley expansion zone.

questions.question: What is the name of the Terran Ghost psychic who was betrayed and transformed into the Queen of Blades in StarCraft?
questions.explanation_correct: Sarah Kerrigan was abandoned on Tarsonis by Arcturus Mengsk, leading to her capture and transformation by the Overmind.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nova is another Terran Ghost agent, Selendis is a Protoss Executor, and Hanson is a Terran scientist.

questions.question: What is the name of the utopian, wealthy city of progress that sits above the polluted underground district of Zaun in League of Legends?
questions.explanation_correct: Piltover and Zaun are twin cities representing the dichotomy of clean technological progress and chemtech industrial slums.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Demacia is an anti-magic kingdom, Noxus is a meritocratic expansionist empire, and Ionia is a spiritually harmonic land.

questions.question: What is the name of the dominant Japanese megacorporation led by Saburo Arasaka in the Cyberpunk universe?
questions.explanation_correct: Arasaka is a family-run megacorporation specializing in corporate security, banking, and cyberware production.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Militech is their primary arms-manufacturing rival, Kang Tao is Chinese-based, and Biotechnica focuses on genetics and cloning.

questions.question: What is the name of the Quarian machinist companion of Commander Shepard who wears a full-body environmental suit?
questions.explanation_correct: Tali'Zorah is a Quarian technician on her Pilgrimage who joins Shepard's crew to expose the rogue Spectre Saren.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Liara is an Asari archaeologist, Miranda is a Cerberus officer, and Jack is a powerful human biotic.

questions.question: What is the name of the spectral cavalcade of elves from another world who pursue Ciri in the Witcher games?
questions.explanation_correct: The Wild Hunt (Aen Elle elves from Tir ná Lia led by Eredin) pursues Ciri to utilize her Elder Blood to open gates between worlds.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Order of the Flaming Rose is a Temerian religious order, the Scoia'tael are non-human freedom fighters, and the Nauzicaa Brigade is a Nilfgaardian cavalry unit.

questions.question: What is the name of the aerospace corporate conglomerate that opens portal to Hell on Mars in the Doom series?
questions.explanation_correct: The Union Aerospace Corporation conducts high-risk research in teleportation and Argent energy extraction on Mars.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aperture is from Portal, Weyland-Yutani is from the Alien universe, and Vault-Tec is from Fallout.

questions.question: What is the name of the psychotic, unstable career criminal who is one of the three main playable characters in Grand Theft Auto V?
questions.explanation_correct: Trevor Philips is a former military pilot turned drug dealer and heist planner who runs Trevor Philips Industries.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Michael is a retired bank robber in witness protection, Franklin is a repo man, and Lamar is Franklin's eccentric friend.

questions.question: What is the name of the quasi-religious military order in the Fallout series dedicated to preserving pre-war technology, known for wearing Power Armor?
questions.explanation_correct: The Brotherhood of Steel was founded by former US Army captain Roger Maxson to control high tech in the wasteland.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Enclave represents remnants of the pre-war US government, the NCR is a democratic republic, and the Institute builds synths.

questions.question: What is the name of the clumsy, talkative personality core who helps the player at the start of Portal 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Wheatley is an intelligence dampening core who accidentally helps Chell reactivate GLaDOS before turning power-mad himself.
questions.explanation_incorrect: GLaDOS is the facility's AI overseer, Cave Johnson is the deceased founder (heard in recordings), and Atlas is a co-op testing robot.

questions.question: From which Italian Renaissance city does Ezio Auditore, the protagonist of Assassin's Creed II, Brotherhood, and Revelations, originate?
questions.explanation_correct: Ezio was born in Florence to the Auditore family, fleeing the city after his father and brothers were executed.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ezio travels to Venice and Rome later in his quest for vengeance, and Milan is not a primary setting.

questions.question: Who is the divine parent of the protagonist (the Bhaalspawn) in the classic Baldur's Gate dilogy?
questions.explanation_correct: The Lord of Murder, Bhaal, foresaw his death and walked Toril to sire mortal offspring who would preserve his divine essence.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cyric is the god of lies who stole Bhaal's portfolio, Helm is the watcher god, and Elminster is a famous archmage.

questions.question: What is the name of the military fortress-nation established by Big Boss in the original 1987 Metal Gear game?
questions.explanation_correct: Outer Heaven was founded by Big Boss to allow soldiers to fight free from the manipulation of politicians.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Shadow Moses is the Alaskan island from MGS, Zanzibar Land is the setting of Metal Gear 2, and Philanthropy is a NGO anti-Metal Gear group.

questions.question: What is the name of the dangerous, lava-filled underworld dimension in Minecraft reached via an obsidian portal?
questions.explanation_correct: The Nether acts as a hell-like fast travel dimension filled with lava, Blaze rods, and Soul Sand.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The End is the void home of the Ender Dragon, Aether is a famous sky mod dimension, and Deep Dark is a cave biome.

questions.question: What is the military rank and name/designation of the main protagonist of the Halo series, a legendary SPARTAN-II soldier?
questions.explanation_correct: Master Chief Petty Officer John-117 is the cybernetically enhanced supersoldier hero of the Halo franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Johnson is a marine non-com ally, Noble Six is the hero of Halo: Reach, and Carter is the leader of Noble Team.

questions.question: What is the name of the secretive guild of assassins in the Elder Scrolls who worship the void deity Sithis?
questions.explanation_correct: The Dark Brotherhood is a cult-like assassin organization led by the Night Mother and her Listener.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Morag Tong is the legal Dunmer assassin guild of Morrowind, Thieves Guild avoids killing, and Companions are honorable mercenaries.

questions.question: What is the name of the manic Zaunite criminal who uses a rocket launcher named Fishbones and a minigun, starred in Arcane?
questions.explanation_correct: Jinx is the blue-haired loose cannon of Zaun, whose tragic descent into madness is chronicled in the Arcane series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Vi is her gauntlet-wielding sister, Caitlyn is the enforcer sheriff of Piltover, and Lux is a Demacian mage.

questions.question: What is the name of the black-haired sorceress of Vengerberg, who is Geralt's true love and Ciri's mother figure?
questions.explanation_correct: Yennefer of Vengerberg is famous for her lilac and gooseberries perfume and her signature black and white clothing.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Triss is the red-haired sorceress, Keira resides in Velen in Witcher 3, and Philippa led the Lodge of Sorceresses.

questions.question: What is the name of the Prothean megastructure design that, when connected to the Citadel, can destroy the Reapers?
questions.explanation_correct: The Crucible is an enormous energy-projecting device designed over multiple cycles to interface with the Catalyst.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mass Relays allow FTL travel, Ilos is a ruined Prothean planet, and the Conduit is a prototype relay on Ilos.

questions.question: What is the name of the runeblade that corrupted Prince Arthas Menethil and bonded him with the Lich King?
questions.explanation_correct: Frostmourne was a cursed runeblade forged by the Nathrezim to enslave the mind of whoever drew it.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Shadowmourne is a player-crafted legendary, Ashbringer is the holy anti-undead blade, and Doomhammer is Thrall's weapon.

questions.question: Which object in the original Portal game is introduced as the player's companion in testing before GLaDOS forces its destruction?
questions.explanation_correct: The Weighted Companion Cube is a testing cube marked with pink hearts, which the player must incinerate to complete Chamber 17.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Turrets are active hazards, the cake is a lie, and personality cores are detached from GLaDOS at the end.

questions.question: What is the name of the lawless, desert planet containing alien Vaults that serves as the primary setting for Borderlands?
questions.explanation_correct: Pandora is a harsh wasteland planet filled with corporations, bandits, and dangerous indigenous wildlife.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Elpis is Pandora's moon, Promethea is Atlas's metropolis planet, and Athenas is a monastic world.

questions.question: What is the name of Kratos's son who accompanies him on his journey to the highest peak in the realms?
questions.explanation_correct: Atreus is Kratos's archer son. Under his giant heritage from his mother Laufey, he is known as Loki.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Baldur is the main antagonist, Freyr is a Vanir god, and Loki is his giant name revealed at the end.

questions.question: What is the name of the ancient, highly advanced precursor race that created humanity and the Pieces of Eden in Assassin's Creed?
questions.explanation_correct: The Isu (also known as the First Civilization) possessed triple-helix DNA and ruled Earth before a solar flare wiped out their civilization.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Protheans are from Mass Effect, Forerunners are from Halo, and Archons are from StarCraft or theology.

questions.question: What is the name of the catastrophic research incident at Black Mesa that triggered a resonance cascade in Half-Life?
questions.explanation_correct: The Black Mesa Incident occurred during an experiment with an anomalous materials sample, opening portal storms across Earth.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aperture was not involved, Lazarus is from ME2, and Awakening Day is incorrect.

questions.question: What is the name of Naked Snake's legendary mentor and leader of the Cobra Unit, whom he must assassinate in MGS3?
questions.explanation_correct: The Boss defected to the Soviet Union to secure the Philosophers' Legacy, forcing her student Snake to kill her in a field of lilies.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Eva is an undercover spy, Sniper Wolf is from MGS1, and The Sorrow is a spirit medium and The Boss's former partner.

questions.question: What are the genetically mutated young girls who harvest ADAM from corpses in Rapture called?
questions.explanation_correct: Little Sisters are conditioned children who carry sea slugs inside their stomachs to process ADAM, guarded by Big Daddies.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Splicers are the aggressive mutated citizens of Rapture, and orphans/witches are incorrect.

questions.question: What is the name of the colossal, silent sphere hovering above Earth that ushered in humanity's Golden Age in Destiny?
questions.explanation_correct: The Traveler is a benevolent, paracausal machine entity that defends humanity against the Black Fleet and the Darkness.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Darkness is the opposing force, the Witness is the main villain of the saga, and Cepheus is a constellation.

questions.question: What is the name of the peaceful, wine-producing Nilfgaardian duchy that serves as the setting for the Blood and Wine expansion?
questions.explanation_correct: Toussaint is a colorful vassal duchy of Nilfgaard untouched by the war, ruled by Duchess Anna Henrietta.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cintra is Ciri's homeland sacked by Nilfgaard, Temeria is a Northern Kingdom, and Nazair is an annexed southern region.

questions.question: What is the name of the legendary netrunner who created the Soulkiller program and exists beyond the Blackwall in Cyberpunk 2077?
questions.explanation_correct: Alt Cunningham was a brilliant programmer kidnapped by Arasaka to develop the Soulkiller, eventually becoming an AI entity beyond the Blackwall.
questions.explanation_incorrect: T-Bug is a netrunner who dies during the heist, Rogue is the queen of Afterlife, and Evelyn Parker is a doll at Lizzie's Bar.

questions.question: What is the name of the enigmatic, 260-year-old ruler of New Vegas who resides inside the Lucky 38 casino?
questions.explanation_correct: Mr. House is the pre-war industrialist who saved Vegas from atomic destruction using missile defense networks and rules via Securitrons.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Caesar is the leader of Caesar's Legion, Benny is the mobster who shot the Courier, and Victor is a friendly cowboy Securitron.

questions.question: What is the name of the faction of High Elven supremacists who enforce the ban on Talos worship in Skyrim?
questions.explanation_correct: The Thalmor are the diplomatic and military agents of the Aldmeri Dominion, acting as inquisitors in Skyrim.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Imperial Guard serves the Empire, Stormcloaks are Ulfric's rebels, and the Blades are remnants of the Emperor's dragonguard.

questions.question: What is the name of the massive Reaper dreadnought that posed as Saren's flagship and brainwashed him in Mass Effect?
questions.explanation_correct: Sovereign was left behind in dark space to trigger the Citadel relay, using organic indoctrination to manipulate Saren Arterius.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Harbinger is the leader of the Reapers in ME2 and ME3, Normandy is Shepard's ship, and Nazara is the Geth name for Sovereign.

questions.question: What is the name of the legendary order of warriors in Dragon Age tasked with fighting the Blight, who undergo the Joining ritual?
questions.explanation_correct: The Grey Wardens consume darkspawn blood to gain the ability to sense darkspawn and permanently slay Archdemons.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Templars police mages, Seekers are inquisitorial agents, and Silent Sisters are tongue-less dwarven warriors.

questions.question: What is the name of the treacherous orc warlock who formed the Shadow Council and led his people to drink the blood of Mannoroth?
questions.explanation_correct: Gul'dan was the first Orcish warlock, who served Kil'jaeden and brokered the demonic blood pact that cursed the Orcish race.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thrall is Durotan's son and Horde savior, Durotan refused the blood pact, and Kil'jaeden is the demon lord who manipulated Gul'dan.

questions.question: What is the name of the massive, mechanical bird-like creature that acts as Elizabeth's jailer and guardian in Columbia?
questions.explanation_correct: Songbird was designed to keep Elizabeth imprisoned in her tower, reacting with violent rage to any attempts to rescue her.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Big Daddy is from Rapture, Handyman is a cyborg enemy, and Motorized Patriot is an automaton with Gatling gun.

questions.question: What is the name of the charismatic leader of the outlaw gang in Red Dead Redemption 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Dutch van der Linde is the idealistic leader who slowly loses his sanity and values as civilization closes in on his gang.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Hosea is the veteran co-founder, Micah is the rat antagonist, and Arthur Morgan is the protagonist of RDR2.

questions.question: What is the name of the massive crystal inside Mount Arreat that hidden the mortal realm from Heaven and Hell, destroyed in Diablo II?
questions.explanation_correct: The Worldstone was corrupted by Baal, the Lord of Destruction, forcing the Archangel Tyrael to shatter it with his sword El'druin.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Black Soulstone binds the Great Evils in Diablo III, and the other options are minor lore objects.

questions.question: What is the name of the eccentric, lemons-hating founder of Aperture Science heard in historic testing tracts in Portal 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Cave Johnson was the CEO of Aperture Science who died of moon rock poisoning, famous for his speech about combative lemons.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Caroline was his secretary, Rattmann is the 'Ratman' who leaves wall murals, and Breen is the administrator from Half-Life 2.

questions.question: What is the name of Eli Vance's daughter who assists Gordon Freeman in the resistance against the Combine?
questions.explanation_correct: Alyx Vance is a prominent figure in the Resistance, who later starred in her own VR prequel game, Half-Life: Alyx.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mossman is a double-agent scientist, Chell is the silent protagonist of Portal, and Gina Cross is from HL: Decay.

questions.question: What is the name of the fallen Titan who founded the demonic Burning Legion to purge the universe of Void corruption?
questions.explanation_correct: Sargeras is the prime antagonist of the Warcraft franchise, a fallen Pantheon Champion who initiated the Burning Crusade.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aman'Thul is the leader of the Pantheon, Aggrammar is a Titan champion, and Loken is a corrupted watcher.

questions.question: What is the name of the AI installed on the Normandy SR-2 who obtains a physical synthetic body in Mass Effect 3?
questions.explanation_correct: EDI is the shipboard AI of the Normandy who later occupies a cybernetic body chassis and develops feelings for Joker.
questions.explanation_incorrect: SAM is the Pathfinder AI in ME: Andromeda, Geth Prime is a combat unit, and Cortana is from Halo.

questions.question: What is the name of the terraforming AI created by Elisabeth Sobeck to reboot Earth's biosphere in Horizon Zero Dawn?
questions.explanation_correct: GAIA is the benevolent AI core of Project Zero Dawn, which sacrificed itself to prevent HADES from wiping out humanity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: HADES is the extinction protocol subclass, HEPHAESTUS builds the machines, and CYAN is a local geothermal AI.

questions.question: What is the name of the young survivor from the VDNKh station who is the main protagonist of the Metro video game trilogy?
questions.explanation_correct: Artyom is a Spartan Ranger and survivor of the post-apocalyptic nuclear war in the Moscow metro system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Miller is the commander of the Spartan Rangers, Khan is a mystical wanderer, and Kirill is a child saved in Novosibirsk.

questions.question: What is the name of the maiden who offers the player a pact in Elden Ring, acting as a Finger Maiden and granting the Spectral Steed Whistle?
questions.explanation_correct: Melina guide the Tarnished to the Erdtree, serving to channel runes into strength in exchange for safe passage.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ranni is the four-armed lunar witch, Malenia is the Blade of Miquella, and Marika is the vessel of the Elden Ring.

questions.question: Which elven sage (Aen Saevherne) acts as Ciri's mentor and has researched the Elder Blood in the Witcher universe?
questions.explanation_correct: Avallac'h is a powerful elven sage who protects Ciri and helps her fulfill her destiny to end the White Frost.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ge'els is a high-ranking elven viceroy, Auberon is the King of the Alders, and Eredin is the main antagonist.

questions.question: What is the name of the protagonist's son in Fallout 4, who was kidnapped as a baby and became the leader of the Institute known as Father?
questions.explanation_correct: Shaun's unmutated DNA was harvested to create generation 3 synths, and he aged into the elder leader 'Father' while the player slept in cryo.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nate is the default male player character, Kellogg is the cybernetic mercenary, and Preston is a Minuteman officer.

questions.question: What is the name of the last living Dwarf (Dwemer) in the Elder Scrolls lore, whom the Nerevarine meets in Morrowind?
questions.explanation_correct: Yagrum Bagarn survived the mass disappearance of the Dwemer because he was in an Outer Realm at the time.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dumac was the last king of the Dwemer, Kagrenac was the high architect who used Lorkhan's heart, and Vivec is a living god.

questions.question: What is the name commonly given to the mysterious suit-wearing entity who monitors Gordon Freeman in the Half-Life series?
questions.explanation_correct: The G-Man possesses reality-bending powers, placing Gordon Freeman in stasis at the end of the original game and releasing him for HL2.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Administrator is Wallace Breen, Sam Fisher is from Splinter Cell, and the Nihilanth is the master of Xen.

questions.question: What is the name of the harsh, war-torn Krogan homeworld in the Mass Effect universe?
questions.explanation_correct: Tuchanka is the irradiated Krogan homeworld characterized by radioactive ruins and giant Thresher Maws.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thessia is the Asari homeworld, Sur'Kesh is the Salarian homeworld, and Rannoch is the Quarian/Geth planet.

questions.question: What is the name of the magical, blue-glowing ore mined in the penal colony of Khorinis in the Gothic series?
questions.explanation_correct: Magic Ore possesses magical properties and is essential for forging weapons strong enough to fight Orcs.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mithril is from Middle-earth, Lyrium is from Dragon Age, and Elerium is from XCOM.

questions.question: Which Archangel of Wisdom turned into the Aspect of Death, acting as the final boss of the Reaper of Souls expansion in Diablo III?
questions.explanation_correct: Malthael, the former Archangel of Wisdom, became the Angel of Death and sought to wipe out humanity using the Black Soulstone.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Imperius is the Archangel of Valor, Tyrael became mortal, and Itherael is the Archangel of Fate.

questions.question: What is the name of the transitory land where the lords of cinder converge, serving as the setting of Dark Souls III?
questions.explanation_correct: Lothric is the setting of DS3, where different lands and eras pull together as the fire fades.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Lordran is from DS1, Drangleic is from DS2, and Anor Londo is the city of gods found within Lothric.

questions.question: What is the name of the powerful religious cult in Dead Space that worships the Markers and seeks Convergence?
questions.explanation_correct: Unitology is a fanatical religion founded on the teachings of Michael Altman, which actively assists the spread of Necromorph outbreaks.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional religious groups unrelated to Dead Space.

questions.question: What is the name of the heavily armed rapid-response medical service provider in Night City?
questions.explanation_correct: Trauma Team operates armored AV-4 flying ambulances with tactical soldiers to retrieve high-paying premium cardholders.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Arasaka and Militech are defense conglomerates, and Biotechnica focuses on bio-engineering rather than medical rescue.

questions.question: What is the common name of the Zero-Point Energy Field Manipulator, Gordon Freeman's iconic physics-based tool?
questions.explanation_correct: The Gravity Gun is a key tool in Half-Life 2 used to solve physics puzzles and launch heavy objects at Combine soldiers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Portal Gun is from Portal, Tau Cannon is an energy weapon, and Glue Gun is not a Half-Life weapon.

questions.question: What is the name of the Grand Master of the Order of the Flaming Rose in the first Witcher game?
questions.explanation_correct: Jacques de Aldersberg leads the Order, stealing Witcher secrets to breed mutants. He is heavily implied to be Alvin, a Source child who traveled back in time.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Siegfried is a young paladin, Foltest is the king of Temeria, and Roderick is a conspirator noble.

questions.question: What is the name of the rebel paramilitary group led by Jim Raynor after breaking away from the Sons of Korhal?
questions.explanation_correct: Raynor's Raiders is an outlaw resistance group fighting against the corrupt Terran Dominion.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dominion forces serve Arcturus Mengsk, while the other factions are unaffiliated mercenary groups.

questions.question: What is the name of the massive, star-shaped ancient space station that serves as the political capital of the galaxy in Mass Effect?
questions.explanation_correct: The Citadel is a massive space station created by the Reapers to act as a hub for galactic civilization and a gateway to dark space.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Omega is a lawless asteroid station, Ilos is a ruined world, and Noveria is a frozen corporate laboratory planet.

questions.question: Which fragment of the Elden Ring, representing the natural cycle of life and death, was stolen by Ranni on the Night of the Black Knives?
questions.explanation_correct: Stolen from Maliketh, the Rune of Death was used to forge black knife blades that killed Godwyn the Golden's soul and Ranni's body.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Rune of Flame is incorrect, the Unborn rune belongs to Rennala, and the Erdtree has no specific rune by that name.

questions.question: What is the name of the wheel-chair bound first hunter who guides the player in the Hunter's Dream in Bloodborne?
questions.explanation_correct: Gehrman is the host of the Hunter's Dream, who forged the first trick weapons and guides new hunters on their night of the hunt.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Gascoigne is a corrupted hunter boss, Micolash is the host of the Nightmare, and Laurence founded the Healing Church.

questions.question: What is the name of the international pharmaceutical corporation that secretly developed biological weapons, including the T-Virus?
questions.explanation_correct: Umbrella Corporation used a pharmaceutical front to research mutagenic viruses, leading directly to the Raccoon City incident.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Weyland-Yutani is from the Alien franchise, Tricell is a rival bio-weapons company in RE5, and AAS is a fake acronym.

questions.question: What is the name of the pre-war corporate entity contracted by the US government to build underground vaults for social experiments?
questions.explanation_correct: Vault-Tec built the vaults not to save humanity, but to gather data for a planned interstellar colony ship through human experimentation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: RobCo built robots and computers, Poseidon controlled power grids, and West-Tek engineered Power Armor and the FEV virus.

questions.question: What is the name of the stem-cell substance harvested from sea slugs that grants superhuman abilities in the BioShock series?
questions.explanation_correct: ADAM is a raw mutagenic material that allows users to rewrite their genetic code, fueling the societal collapse of Rapture.
questions.explanation_incorrect: EVE is the serum used to power plasmid abilities, Plasmid is the resulting power itself, and Soma is from Brave New World or the game SOMA.

questions.question: What is the name of the modern-day bartender who is kidnapped by Abstergo to access the genetic memories of Altaïr and Ezio?
questions.explanation_correct: Desmond Miles relived his ancestors' memories using the Animus, gaining their skills through the Bleeding Effect.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Clay was Subject 16, Shaun is the British historian ally, and William is Desmond's father and Assassin mentor.

questions.question: What are the legendary scrolls of prophecy that describe historical and future events, causing blindness to unprepared readers?
questions.explanation_correct: The Elder Scrolls are timeless fragments of creation that document all possibilities, studied by the Ancestor Moth monks.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Oghma Infinium is Hermaeus Mora's artifact, Black Books transport readers to Apocrypha, and Magnus's scrolls are incorrect.

questions.question: What is the name of the massive whirlpool in the center of the Great Sea of Azeroth, created by the collapse of the Well of Eternity?
questions.explanation_correct: The Maelstrom is a permanent oceanic storm formed ten thousand years ago during the Sundering of Kalimdor.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Great Rift is generic, Nazjatar lies beneath the waters, and Eye of the Storm is a PvP Battleground.

questions.question: What is the name of the magical axe wielded by Kratos in the Norse era of God of War, which returns to his hand when thrown?
questions.explanation_correct: The Leviathan Axe was forged by the Huldra brothers to oppose the power of Mjolnir, infused with the ice magic of the Frost Giants.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Blades of Chaos are Kratos's fire blades, Draupnir is his spear, and Mjolnir is Thor's hammer.

questions.question: What is the biological relationship of Aloy to the ancient scientist Elisabeth Sobeck in Horizon Zero Dawn?
questions.explanation_correct: Aloy was cloned by the GAIA AI using the DNA of Dr. Elisabeth Sobeck to bypass genetic security locks on ancient facilities.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aloy was created synthetically by a facility, making her a genetic duplicate rather than a biological descendant.

questions.question: What is the true identity of the elven companion Solas in Dragon Age: Inquisition?
questions.explanation_correct: Solas is revealed to be Fen'Harel, the elven god of betrayal, who intends to tear down the Veil he created even if it destroys the current world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mythal is the goddess associated with Flemeth, and Elgar'nan and Falon'Din are other members of the Evanuris.

questions.question: What is the name of the professional, stoic lieutenant from the 57th precinct who partners with Harry Du Bois in Disco Elysium?
questions.explanation_correct: Lieutenant Kim Kitsuragi is the iconic companion of the player, providing logical support and balance to Harry's chaotic mental state.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Titus leads the Hardie Boys, Evrart is the Union boss, and Jean is Harry's distressed RCM partner.

questions.question: What is the name of the ruined underground kingdom of bugs that serves as the setting for Hollow Knight?
questions.explanation_correct: Hallownest was a prosperous empire of sapient bugs that fell into decay after a plague of infection spread throughout its chambers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dirtmouth is the surface town, Pharloom is the setting of Silksong, and Deepnest is a dark region within Hallownest.

questions.question: What is the name of the talking golden flower who greets the player at the start of Undertale?
questions.explanation_correct: Flowey tells the player 'In this world, it's kill or be killed.' He is later revealed to be the soulless remains of Asriel Dreemurr.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Asgore is the king, Toriel is the caretaker of the Ruins, and Sans is the iconic pun-loving skeleton.

questions.question: What is the name of the main protagonist of Red Dead Redemption (2010), coerced into hunting down his former gang members?
questions.explanation_correct: John Marston is the tragic cowboy hero who tracks down Javier Escuella, Bill Williamson, and Dutch to free his family.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Arthur Morgan is the hero of the prequel, Dutch is the gang leader, and Bill is John's former comrade turned target.

questions.question: What is the name of the narcissistic CEO of Hyperion and main antagonist of Borderlands 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Handsome Jack is the sarcastic dictator of Pandora who uses the orbital station Helios to watch over the planet.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Claptrap is the yellow robot companion, Marcus is the arms dealer, and Timothy is Jack's body double.
